# ✦ ShineX - Premium Particle Cosmetics ✦

> **32 unique particle effects** across 4 categories. Lightweight, async, fully configurable.

![Banner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0110aad9da5baa208c8394e6db76c7f2741d7da4.jpeg)

---

## ✨ What is ShineX?

ShineX is a premium cosmetic plugin that adds **stunning particle effects** to your server. Every effect is rendered asynchronously for maximum performance — zero lag, pure aesthetics.

![Main Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aecb27f743b693735ece9bb908c41c4dcdb593ad.png)

---

## 🎭 5 Categories, 40 Effects

### 🔥 Auras (8 effects)
Particle auras that surround the player's body.

| Effect | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Quantum Singularity | A swirling vortex that bends space |
| Celestial Sphere | Armillary rings of pure starlight |
| Fractal Illusion | Endless shifting geometric patterns |
| Time Dilation | Clocks and time warps spiral around you |
| Crystalline Matrix | Crystals of light form a geometric cage |
| Vortex of Souls | Tormented spirits in a dark vortex |
| Abyssal Runes | Ancient glyphs of forbidden knowledge |
| Phoenix Rebirth | Rise from the ashes in a blaze of glory |

## 🖥️ Premium GUI

<!-- SCREENSHOT: GUI menu kategorii z kilkoma efektami, widoczne gradienty i statusy -->
![Category Menu](WSTAW_SCREENSHOT_MENU_KATEGORII)

- **Player head** in main menu showing all active effects
- **Gradient text** and hex colors throughout the entire UI
- **Smart status indicators** — equipped ✔, available, locked ⛔
- **One-click toggle** — click to equip, click again to unequip
- **Remove button** per category for quick unequip
- **Auto-equip toggle** — remembers cosmetics across sessions

---

## ⚡ Performance

- **Fully async** particle computation — all math runs off the main thread
- **Configurable tick rate** — balance smoothness vs. CPU usage
- **Render distance** — only send particles to nearby players
- **Static mode** — effects only appear when standing still (configurable delay)

---

## 🛠️ Features

### Configuration
- `config.yml` — locale, render distance, tick rate, auto-equip, static mode
- `cosmetics.yml` — enable/disable any effect, custom names, icons, permissions, lore
- `gui.yml` — full layout customization, combination modes, slot positions
- **Multi-language** — English & Polish built-in, easy to add more

### Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/shinex` | Open cosmetics GUI | `shinex.use` |
| `/shinex <category> <effect>` | Equip (toggle) a cosmetic | `shinex.use` |
| `/shinex remove <category>` | Remove active cosmetic | `shinex.use` |
| `/shinex <category> <effect> <player>` | Equip on another player | `shinex.admin` |
| `/shinex remove <category> <player>` | Remove from another player | `shinex.admin` |
| `/shinex reload` | Reload all configs | `shinex.admin` |
| `/shinex help` | Show help | `shinex.use` |

### Permissions
| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `shinex.use` | Access to command & GUI | Everyone |
| `shinex.admin` | Admin commands (reload, manage others) | OP |
| `shinex.aura.*` | All aura effects | OP |
| `shinex.wings.*` | All wing effects | OP |
| `shinex.trail.*` | All trail effects | OP |
| `shinex.head.*` | All head effects | OP |
| `shinex.aura.phoenix_rebirth` | Specific effect | OP |

### Combination Modes
- **SINGLE** — only one cosmetic at a time (any category)
- **PER-CATEGORY** — one per category, all categories simultaneously
- **Custom pairs** — define exactly which categories can coexist (e.g. `AURA+TRAIL`)

### PlaceholderAPI Support
| Placeholder | Returns |
|-------------|---------|
| `%shinex_active_aura%` | Active aura name or `None` |
| `%shinex_active_wings%` | Active wings name or `None` |
| `%shinex_active_trail%` | Active trail name or `None` |
| `%shinex_active_head%` | Active head effect name or `None` |
| `%shinex_active_id_aura%` | Active aura ID or `none` |
| `%shinex_has_aura%` | `true` / `false` |
| `%shinex_has_any%` | `true` / `false` |
| `%shinex_count_aura%` | Number of available auras for player |
| `%shinex_total_active%` | Total active cosmetics count |
| `%shinex_total_available%` | Total available cosmetics for player |
| `%shinex_active_list%` | Comma-separated list of active names |
| `%shinex_auto_equip%` | `true` / `false` |

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Paper 1.21.4+** (or forks like Purpur)
- **Java 21+**
- **PlaceholderAPI** *(optional)* — for placeholder support
